full_judgment: 16. Mr. Mahbubey Alam, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondent No. 3 has submitted that the appellants of FMA 152 of 2001 are not entitled for any compensation for requisition of suit plot No. 636. JL No. 251 under Mouza Dhanmondi as the predecessor-in-interest of the appellants had already received compensation of Taka 25,000 on the basis of a solenama reached in Writ Petition No. 42 of 1960 and it is pertinent to be mentioned that the said Writ Petition was filed by the predecessor-in-interest of the appellants and on this score the learned Counsel though he appeared in the said FMA No. 89 of 1992 had also submitted that this appeal should be dismissed. Mr. Mahbubey Alam, has also submitted that the rent amounting to Taka 2,92,000 paid by the respondent by challan for the period from 9-9-1960 to 29-11-1976 and the compensation paid by the Government under section 7(AA) of the Act were made by mistake.
